Normally don’t amplify this type of stuff but very credible $AAPL vulnerability.

Since source is Telegram’s founder:

“ all your data is at risk. Just opening a website can be enough to get you hacked” if using an iOS that’s even a slightly outdated.

That said:

- Seeing exploits left and right, new LLM
cryptographic breakthroughs…

-  France is in a recession.

- brutal crash for global AI/Tech + Japanese, Korean, and Taiwanese markets.

World feels pretty chaotic, but I think we’ll find a little Serenity in 2027.
